display_name: Japan AI Promotion Act (Act No. 53 of 2025): every provision as a row, and the business operator's questions
method: SOLO encoding-a-subject workflow from a pinned brief (one session, Opus 5.5). Sources fetched and deposited with provenance; every quotation generated by srcrefs.py and checked with --strict; nouns first; a provisions table with one row per Article and Supplementary Provision; rules for the provisions that speak to a business operator; tests written by hand from the source. Then an independent test pass by a separate model session (tests-independent.l4, answers written first in tests-independent-answers-first.md); its four failures were encoding errors and were fixed. No human gate.
seat: a business operator that develops, provides or uses AI-related technology (活用事業者, 'utilization business operator', Article 7)
edition_encoded: The Act as enacted (no amending law recorded by e-Gov), in its current revision 507AC0000000053_20250901 (in force from 2025-09-01 per e-Gov); the 2025-06-04 revision differs only by the absence of Chapters III and IV. Japanese: ../../registers/source-bundle/ai-act-ja.txt (rendered from ai-act-ja.xml); English aid: ai-act-en.txt (Translated Date August 22, 2025; Dictionary Version 18.0).
versions_encoded: One text; the in-force state is a date input (Supplementary Provisions Article 1), with the Cabinet Order day for Chapters III and IV a further input.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted Japanese and English texts are reused under the Public Data License (Version 1.0), see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
scope: Every Article (1-28) and Supplementary Provision (1-4) as a row of a provisions table (addressee, Japanese verb form, bearing on a business operator, mechanisms carried: none). Operative rules for Article 2, Article 6(1) and (3), Article 7, Article 16, Article 25(1) and (2), and Supplementary Provisions Article 1. Chapters III and IV other than Article 25, and Supplementary Provisions Articles 3 and 4, are out of scope as rules (machinery; amendments of another Act) and present as rows only. Supplementary Provisions Articles 3 and 4 are read in the English translation only.
not_reviewed: Nobody but the encoding session has read this encoding against the source. No domain expert and no lawyer qualified in Japan has read it. No claim is made that it is correct, complete or fit to be relied on as legal advice.
